environment: Headless native egui tests and a local authenticated Gateway HTTP fixture. No live Gateway, installed desktop runtime, physical Windows interaction, or source-paired visual comparison used.
notes: PAR-0258 exposes Update installed on the native Skills page, sends one explicit-profile POST to /api/skills/hub/update, requires the skills-update action receipt and nonzero PID, polls bounded live action output, fences status by request/profile/Gateway instance/authority epoch/action/PID, and reloads the Skills inventory after successful completion. The start mutation is not automatically replayed when its receipt is uncertain. Tests cover the exact profile-scoped POST/auth header/body, valid and invalid receipts, accessible action and visible log, stale request rejection, and successful status settlement. Full locked feature suite passed 453 library, 15 automation-protocol, and 3 launcher tests; workspace/all-target check, rustfmt, progress generators, task validator, package validator and diff check passed. Live Gateway update, packaged Windows behavior, cancellation/reconciliation, per-skill update workflows and source-paired acceptance remain open; capability status is partial.
